review.en: A ferryman and his granddaughter Cuicui live by a river crossing on the Hunan-Sichuan border, and two brothers come courting. Shen Congwen writes this short novel with the clarity of water: festivals, boat races, songs across the river, and a sorrow that arrives without fuss. The most beautiful prose pastoral of modern Chinese.
review.zh: 湘西茶峒的渡口，老船夫和孙女翠翠相依为命，船总家的两兄弟都喜欢上了她。沈从文把这个中篇写得像河水一样清澈：端午的龙舟、对岸的山歌、不动声色到来的忧伤。现代中文里最美的田园牧歌。
